snippet.title: "Turn Around, It's a Trap!" — Homeless Girl Saved 28 Bikers, What They Did Next Left Her in Tears
snippet.description:
She had no phone, no address and no ID. All she had was a notebook full of license plates—and the nerve to stand in front of 28 motorcycles.

Josie Avery aged out of foster care with a garbage bag and a bus ticket. For fourteen months she has lived in a trailer under the Old Ferry Bridge. One Sunday morning she runs out of the pines and stands in the middle of the road as a whole motorcycle club rides down the hill to honor Eli, killed in a hit-and-run eight months ago. "Stop! Turn around—it's a trap!" The curve is greased with oil, the railing has no bolts, a man with a rifle waits across the river, and someone sits in a boat under the bridge so nobody makes it out of the water.

The club's leader, Pop, is the only witness at tomorrow's trial. The bikers catch the road crew red-handed. Then a county deputy rolls down the hill, calls the bikers an armed gang, and looks the homeless girl up and down: no address, no ID, oil on her shoes. He opens the back door of his patrol car. She rides with him and they all go home—or everybody goes to jail, and Pop misses court.

👉 Watch till the end — the girl nobody ever bothered to ask is about to show a whole town what she wrote down.

If you love stories where the person everyone overlooks turns out to be the only one who was paying attention, subscribe for a new story every week.

This is a fictional story made for entertainment. All characters, places and events are invented.

#BikerStory #HomelessGirl #Story

snippet.title: Halloween Playlist 2026👻 Most Iconic Halloween Songs of All Time | The Nightmare Before Christmas
snippet.description:
Halloween Playlist 2026👻 Most Iconic Halloween Songs of All Time | The Nightmare Before Christmas

#halloween #halloweensongs #halloweenplaylist

Step into a world where Halloween magic never fades! 🎃👻

Welcome to our Halloween Playlist 2026, featuring a collection of our favorite iconic Halloween songs, lovingly reimagined through cover versions to celebrate the music we’ve enjoyed over the years.

This playlist is a personal passion project, created out of our love for Halloween music and the joy of sharing these timeless songs with fellow Halloween enthusiasts. Each cover is our way of revisiting the melodies that make this season so special, while bringing our own creative touch to the experience.

🎬 Inspired by The Nightmare Before Christmas:

The visual atmosphere is a heartfelt tribute to the beloved 1993 film 𝑻𝒉𝒆 𝑵𝒊𝒈𝒉𝒕𝒎𝒂𝒓𝒆 𝑩𝒆𝒇𝒐𝒓𝒆 𝑪𝒉𝒓𝒊𝒔𝒕𝒎𝒂𝒔, whose unforgettable characters, whimsical gothic style, and magical storytelling have inspired generations of Halloween fans.

We wanted to capture a little of that same enchanting spirit, combining our love for the film with the Halloween songs that have become part of our favorite seasonal memories.

🍬A Note About This Project: This is an independently created, fan-inspired music project made to celebrate our appreciation for Halloween music and cinema. The songs featured are cover interpretations, created as a tribute to the original artists and compositions.

The visuals are inspired by our admiration for 𝑻𝒉𝒆 𝑵𝒊𝒈𝒉𝒕𝒎𝒂𝒓𝒆 𝑩𝒆𝒇𝒐𝒓𝒆 𝑪𝒉𝒓𝒊𝒔𝒕𝒎𝒂𝒔. This project is not officially affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the film's creators. All rights to the original film, characters, and musical compositions remain with their respective copyright holders.

Thank you for listening and sharing the Halloween spirit with us! 🧡

Jason Mraz - I'm Yours (Lyrics)

Well, you done done me and you bet I felt it
I tried to be chill, but you're so hot that I melted
I fell right through the cracks
Now I'm trying to get back

Before the cool done run out
I'll be giving it my bestest

It cannot wait,
I'm yours.

No more, no more.
It cannot wait,
I'm sure.
There's no need to complicate.
Our time is short.
This is our fate,
I'm yours.

Do you want to come on, scooch on over closer, dear
And I will nibble your ear

I've been spending way too long checking my tongue in the mirror
And bending over backwards just to try to see it clearer
But my breath fogged up the glass
And so I drew a new face and I laughed.

I guess what I'll be saying is there ain't no better reason
To rid yourself of vanities and just go with the seasons.
It's what we aim to do.
Our name is our virtue.

But I won't hesitate
No more, no more.
It cannot wait,
I'm yours.

Well, open up your mind and see like me,
Open up your plans and damn you're free.
Look into your heart and you'll find that the sky is yours.
So please don't, please don't, please don't...
There's no need to complicate.
'Cause our time is short.
This oh, this oh, this is our fate.
I'm yours.

Oh, I'm yours
Oh, I'm yours
Oh, oh,
Baby, do you believe, I'm yours?
You best believe, you best believe, I'm yours.

snippet.description:
The Cave… Track 1 of 4 from the Al-Kahf (Vocals Only) album.

Imagine falling asleep in a cave and waking up 309 years later.

Inspired by the People of the Cave (Ashab Al-Kahf), young believers who left everything behind to protect the one thing they refused to lose...their faith in Allah.

When the world turned against them, they turned to Allah. What began as a search for refuge became a miracle remembered for generations.

But while some are tested by what they lose, others are tested by everything they are given…

snippet.title: Firearms Expert Reacts to Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Campaign Guns | EXP
snippet.description:
Jonathan Ferguson, an expert in firearms history, and the Keeper of Firearms & Artillery at the Royal Armouries Museum in the UK, reacts to the the weapons and missions of the Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 campaign, including the enormous Astaroth .57 anti-materiel rifle, THAT nightclub mission, and an absolutely cursed ‘modernised’ PPSh-41.

00:00 - Intro
01:09 - Haijin City Invasion
01:57 - Han 86
07:08 - Krait P68 / Nightclub Mission
09:41 - MAR-9
14:03 - PM-40 Anvil
16:48 - Why not check out our Patreon?
17:14 - Astaroth .57
19:41 - PPSh-41
25:49 - M4
28:15 - Type 73
30:55 - X-58 Nyx
34:04 - Patriot XMR

In this episode of Expert Reacts on EXP, Jonathan Ferguson--an expert in firearms history and the Keeper of Firearms & Artillery at the Royal Armouries Museum in the UK--breaks down the guns of the Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 campaign, and compares them to their real-life counterparts with artefacts from the Royal Armouries archive.

If you're interested in seeing more of Jonathan's work, you can check out more from the Royal Armouries right here. - https://www.youtube.com/user/RoyalArmouries  

If you would like to support the Royal Armouries, you can make a charitable donation to the museum here. - https://royalarmouries.org/support-us/donate

And if you would like to become a member of the Royal Armouries, you can get a membership here. - https://royalarmouries.org/support-us/become-a-member

You can purchase Jonathan's book here. - https://www.headstamppublishing.com/bullpup-rifle-book

You can subscribe to the Armax Journal that Jonathan Associate Edited here: https://www.armaxjournal.org/

localized.title: Firearms Expert Reacts to Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Campaign Guns | EXP
localized.description:
Jonathan Ferguson, an expert in firearms history, and the Keeper of Firearms & Artillery at the Royal Armouries Museum in the UK, reacts to the the weapons and missions of the Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 campaign, including the enormous Astaroth .57 anti-materiel rifle, THAT nightclub mission, and an absolutely cursed ‘modernised’ PPSh-41.

00:00 - Intro
01:09 - Haijin City Invasion
01:57 - Han 86
07:08 - Krait P68 / Nightclub Mission
09:41 - MAR-9
14:03 - PM-40 Anvil
16:48 - Why not check out our Patreon?
17:14 - Astaroth .57
19:41 - PPSh-41
25:49 - M4
28:15 - Type 73
30:55 - X-58 Nyx
34:04 - Patriot XMR

In this episode of Expert Reacts on EXP, Jonathan Ferguson--an expert in firearms history and the Keeper of Firearms & Artillery at the Royal Armouries Museum in the UK--breaks down the guns of the Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 campaign, and compares them to their real-life counterparts with artefacts from the Royal Armouries archive.

If you're interested in seeing more of Jonathan's work, you can check out more from the Royal Armouries right here. - https://www.youtube.com/user/RoyalArmouries  

If you would like to support the Royal Armouries, you can make a charitable donation to the museum here. - https://royalarmouries.org/support-us/donate

And if you would like to become a member of the Royal Armouries, you can get a membership here. - https://royalarmouries.org/support-us/become-a-member

You can purchase Jonathan's book here. - https://www.headstamppublishing.com/bullpup-rifle-book

You can subscribe to the Armax Journal that Jonathan Associate Edited here: https://www.armaxjournal.org/

snippet.title: ONE LAST JOB BEFORE WE HARVEST THE COFFEE | Beans and Alpacas FS25 - Episode 9
snippet.description:
Order now! - https://www.farming-simulator.com/dlc-detail.php?dlc_id=fs25beansandalpacas&code=DAGGERWIN

Build your coffee estate and grow a warmer kind of farm life in the Beans & Alpacas Expansion: Travel to Catuaí, a South America-inspired region where coffee plantations cover rolling hills, red soil shapes the land and dense greenery stretches across lower mountain slopes. New crops, animals, production chains and more than 25 new machines await.

Catuaí: Welcome to South America!
Explore a lush, humid valley with narrow roads, dusty streets, scattered rocks and a winding river running through the landscape. A small rural town with colorful buildings, shops and agricultural depots connects the region, while stilt houses line the river shore.

Coffee, Animals & New Gameplay
Cultivate coffee beans as a new crop and expand your livestock with alpacas and Brahman cows. Alpacas add new hands-on interaction through shearing and leading, while wild animals like crocodiles and parrots bring more life to the environment.

Productions, Projects & Collectibles
Create new products such as pigment and resin, and repaint houses for the community, or start production chains for crop processing. Take on the Research Center construction project, find dinosaur skeleton parts and collect your discoveries in the collectible museum.

Machines, Brands & Details
Operate 25+ new machines from Case IH, Ford, John Deere, KUHN, Mercedes-Benz Trucks, New Holland, Valtra, and many more. Colombo Industries joins the series as a new brand, while enhanced ground tool animations and improved effects increase immersion.

Music by Epidemic Sound

Operate 25+ new machines from Case IH, Ford, John Deere, KUHN, Mercedes-Benz Trucks, New Holland, Valtra, and many more. Colombo Industries joins the series as a new brand, while enhanced ground tool animations and improved effects increase immersion.

Music by Epidemic Sound
